package.name: amr_bsp
package.description: Board Support Package style sensor validation. A reusable SensorBSP base class plus IMU, LiDAR and camera validators; the navigation stack consumes sensor data only after it has passed through this layer. Includes PitchGate, which truncates ramp-induced phantom ground returns. Republished messages preserve their ORIGINAL header timestamps. SKELETON: implemented in Phase 2.
